block.guhs.bliksemsmidse_onweerswolkje.l: Rains gently on whatever stands below. Never really flashes, nyeg.
block.guhs.regenboogbrug_pot.lore: Stands at the end of the rainbow. Full again every day.
block.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje_schat.lore: A mountain of golden crumbs. The giant counts them. So they say.
block.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje_kruimel.lore: From the hoard of the sleeping giant. Too pretty to eat. Almost, nyeg.
structure.guhs.regenboogbrug.tooltip: A rainbow you can walk across. At the end stands a pot.
structure.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje.tooltip: A little castle on the highest cloud. Something very big is snoring there.
structure.guhs.bliksemsmidse.tooltip: A dark little cloud that rumbles. The Smith Guh presses clouds into blocks there.
gui.guhs.regenboogbrug.pot.pak: The pot at the end of the rainbow! A handful of cheese nibbles and a chunk of rainbow for you. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.regenboogbrug.pot.leeg: The pot is empty for today. Tomorrow the rainbow will have filled it again, nyeg.
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.slaapt.0: Zzz... nibble... zzz... five more minutes, nyeg...
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.slaapt.1: Zzz... who's touching... my crumbs... zzz...
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.loer.tip: The giant opens one eye. Shhhh! Sneak, no running or jumping.
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.weg.0: AH... AH... ACHOO-GUH! You're blown right out of the castle. The giant rolls over and snores on.
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.weg.1: The giant yawns up a storm: WAHOOOOG. And there you are, outside on a cloud. Landed softly, nyeg.
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.weg.2: One sneeze and you're outside. He didn't even notice.
gui.guhs.reuzenguh.weg.3: Pffft! You fly outside like a bit of fluff. On tiptoe next time, chonk?
gui.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje.schat.pak: You take one golden nibble crumb from the giant's hoard. He just keeps snoring. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.wolkenkasteeltje.schat.leeg: One crumb a day is enough. The giant counts them, so they say. Come back tomorrow, nyeg.
gui.guhs.smidguh.hallo.0: Tap. Tap. Cloud in. Block out. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.smidguh.hallo.1: You give fluff. I press. You build. Chonk.
gui.guhs.smidguh.hallo.2: Hot here. Lightning does the work. I do the rest. Tap.
gui.guhs.smidguh.hallo.3: No fright. Flash is sweet. Rumble is tummy. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.smidguh.geen_pluis: No fluff? Snip a lamb. Then come back. Tap.
gui.guhs.smidguh.geruild: Pressed well. Sturdy block. Wahoog. Tap.
